card.name: Asterisk bullet markers in flattened lists
card.fires_on: The asterisk character used as a bullet marker in web text lists that have been flattened into one line. It appears after a list item or an introductory colon, just before the next item.

modes.description: Asterisk opening a bulleted list after an introductory sentence ending in a colon.
